signature_moves: Greyscale chrome, coloured data: entire UI shell is monochrome charcoal; hue appears ONLY in payload (chart vertices, category glyphs) so every coloured mark reads as pre-attentive figure. Consistent across Mac/iPhone/Watch
Radar/spider chart as the hero subscription-spend viz where peers use bars/pie/lists; echoed by the app icon's radar-dial motif so brand and UI share one form
Value-over-label KPI discipline: $369/$31 largest+brightest, captions small tertiary grey
defects: HIG toolbar violation — app name 'Subscription Day' as the window title (should be empty or view title 'Statistics'); inline titlebar PRO pill (AppKit titles are text-only)
iOS grammar on Mac chrome (lineage tells) — capsule segmented control, iOS-scale density, inline pill badges; excluded from mac canon
Contrast Dilution — radar gridlines <3:1 and dimmest secondary/tertiary greys near/below 4.5:1 text floor; the hero viz is rendered near-invisible
Content typo in shipped cover — 'Apple Fintess+' (Fitness+)

aesthetic.direction: dark-neutral consumer-fintech dashboard — Neo-grotesque-product surface (dark charcoal ramp, rounded SF Pro) with the electric accent deliberately withheld, colour delegated to data; Restrained commitment strategy taken to its limit (chrome ~0% saturation)

psychology: Von Restorff / signal-detection — greyscale field makes each coloured data mark the remembered figure; the app's core legibility trick
Hick's Law — Year/Category segmented control reduces the view scope to a clean binary decision point
Aesthetic-usability effect — polished dark render buys first-contact trust for a money app (halo, not a pass — its low-contrast chart is the crack)
Label/value hierarchy (Weinschenk/stat-tile) — value outranks label on the KPIs, correctly applied
Processing fluency VIOLATED — sub-3:1 radar gridlines cost fluency exactly where comprehension is needed most (the hero viz)
notes: Only inputs were a marketing composite cover.jpg (1200x630) and an icon.webp; NO clean UI screenshots. All app-UI values are estimates at low confidence from a stylized render at unknown scale — no (measured) marks would be honest. The cover also shows an iPhone (iOS) and Apple Watch (watchOS) inside the composite: contrast evidence only, excluded from macOS canon, but they corroborate the multiplatform footprint driving the catalyst/SwiftUI-multiplatform lineage read and the monochrome-chrome/coloured-data grammar. Traffic lights render grey (marketing desaturation vs inactive-window state — ambiguous). Lineage is catalyst OR SwiftUI-multiplatform; can't be split from one render, but corpus consequence (iOS grammar excluded from mac canon) is identical. Icon (radar-dial + restore-arrow + sparkles, dark 3D squircle) noted as brand context per Workflow-A-only scope; NOT digested as a full icon entry — a later icon pass owns icons/subscription-day.md. Task scope was Workflow A only, so no ledger/TASTE/patterns writes were made.
